{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Void Pike''' is a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It is the third [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy to appear in these modes, being stronger on them. Unlike all the ones that appeared before it, it never loses its [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Void Pikes acted as the transporters that drove the army. They would gather supplies, help move weapons, and work on general tasks. They sprint from one place to another without ever seeming to tire, and they never complain. It seems they know every route, including places they have never been to. You can always tell a Void Pike apart by the armor they wear.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Pike''' has dark skin. It wears a purple shirt, purple checkered chestplate, grey gloves, grey pants, brown shoes and a cracked helmet. ==Strategy== *Unlike the [[Lead]] and [[Elite Lead]], '''Void Pike''' does not lose the [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] attribute. Therefore, upgrading towers with lead detection to higher levels is essential to dealing with '''Void Pikes'''. **Towers that deal splash damage, such as the [[Mortar]] and [[Golden Demoman]], are especially useful against '''Void Pikes''' because of how they tend to spawn in groups. **Other towers with lead detection like the [[Engineer]] or [[Saboteur]] can also be used. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HardcoreReworkPI3.png|'''Void Pike''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Pike''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidPikeCA.png|'''Void Pike''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidPikeIconIG.png|'''Void Pike''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Pike''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *The appearance of this enemy appears to have been based on the [[Pike]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Pike''' added. {{Hardcore|[[Void Rusher]]|Wave 27|Void Pike|Wave 28|[[Void Titan]]|Wave 30}} {{Voidcore|[[Void Rusher]]|Wave 27|Void Pike|Wave 28|[[Void Titan]]|Wave 30}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
